strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with fused local ops
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with local multiply-divide operations fused between consecutive all-reduces. Each all-reduce operates on the full (world_size*256) tensor. Dispatch count is 8 all-reduces plus minimal local ops. This is the baseline reference pattern with no structural optimization.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather chain
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter followed by all-gather pair, operating on sharded segments. Each rank works on its local shard (256 elements) during the 7 intermediate local computation steps, then reconstructs full tensor only when needed. Dispatch count is 16 collectives (8 RS + 8 AG), but each operates on smaller payloads (256 vs 57344 elements for RS phase).

strategies.name: Batched vector all-reduce with precomputed coefficients
strategies.desc: Precompute all scaling coefficients (a[r], 1/a[r], a[r]/W combinations) into a lookup structure, then perform all 8 all-reduces with minimal intermediate computation by vectorizing the scale-reduce pattern. Dispatch count remains 8 all-reduces but local compute is optimized via single-pass strided operations instead of per-rank loops.

strategies.name: Pipelined all-reduce with async dispatch
strategies.desc: Issue multiple all-reduce operations back-to-back with computation on independent buffers (ping-pong buffering), allowing collective overlap with local computation from previous iteration. Uses 2-3 buffers cycling through the 8 iterations. Dispatch count is 8 all-reduces but with potential latency hiding through asynchronous execution and buffer reuse.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction with intra-node fusion
strategies.desc:
Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions (within each node's devices) followed by inter-node all-reduces, leveraging faster intra-node bandwidth. For 224 devices, structure as node-local gather+reduce, then cross-node all-reduce, then node-local broadcast. Dispatch count increases (3 collectives per iteration, ~24 total) but uses heterogeneous collective types matched to topology.
